summary: Iteration 551 — Verified 3 new features: (1) Drift Alert Notifications with bell/list/resolve + morning report anomaly injection, (2) Live-Data Forecast Comparison with 14-day Mews impact table + snapshot persistence, (3) Rate Plan Mapping with per-room-type LIVE push (2/2 room types, mocked:false). Backend: 13/14 pytest passed. Frontend: All flows verified interactively — bell showed real drift alerts (from prior mapped push), forecast section rendered 14-day impact, mapping table showed Standard Double ×1 + Deluxe Suite ×1.4, saving multiplier persisted, Fiyat Push produced pms-per-roomtype list with 2 ✅ CANLI entries, Eviivo card also renders mapping section, weekly report + regressions OK.

minor.issue: After push-from-rms with 2 mapped room-types (multipliers ×1.0 and ×1.4), verify-push returns ok:false, max_drift_pct:28.57%, mismatches:2. Verify appears to compare channel rate against a single (unmapped) RMS base price, so the Deluxe ×1.4 push produces a legitimate 40%/28.57% delta. Consider making verify mapping-aware (per room type) so verify.ok stays true after mapped push. Currently this side-effect actually feeds the alert system (which is why the bell showed 2 alerts) — behaviour is arguably desired but internally inconsistent (mapped push considered a drift).

issues: React console warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key' when rendering pms-per-roomtype / mapping table rows — use a unique key (e.g. `${provider}:${roomTypeId}` or index) instead of shared field. Non-blocking but should be fixed.

action_items: (Optional) Make Mews verify-push mapping-aware so it multiplies expected price by room-type multiplier before drift comparison; otherwise every mapped push will auto-create a drift alert.
Fix duplicate-key React warning in per-roomtype push results and/or mapping table rendering.

Morning-report correctly appends 'Dağıtım:' anomaly line for unresolved fresh alerts within last 24h and persists a 14-row forecast_snapshots doc for today.

forecast-accuracy endpoint returns 14 mews_impact rows (with otb_with_mews / otb_without_mews / mews_contribution) + mews_total_contribution_14d=8 as expected; mae_occ_pts null (snapshots not matured) as documented.

seed_data_creation: Inserted temp alert docs (test-alert-1, test-alert-mr) into db.pms_alerts and cleaned up. A real Mews push-from-rms with mapping was executed multiple times (per_room_type 2/2). Morning-report was run twice, refreshing today's forecast_snapshots doc.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration551_features.py covers all 3 new features (drift alerts, forecast-accuracy, rate mapping) plus regressions. Uses pymongo directly (MONGO_URL / DB_NAME from backend/.env) to inject/cleanup pms_alerts docs. The Mews API is real — pushes/verify take 10-60s. After mapped push (multipliers 1.0/1.4) verify-push reports 28.57% drift and auto-creates pms_alerts; this is why the frontend bell shows non-zero alerts even after cleanup. If main agent decides to make verify mapping-aware, update the verify-push regression assertion in this test file.
rca of the issue: verify-push with 2 mapped room-types → drift 28.57%: root cause is that verify_push reads only the root/base rate expectation from RMS and compares against pushed channel prices; but push_from_rms now scales prices per room-type multiplier (Deluxe ×1.4). Verify has no knowledge of the mapping table so the ×1.4 row is flagged as drift. Mitigation options: (a) make verify_push iterate rate-mapping and multiply expected price per row, or (b) restrict verify comparison to the root/base row only. Recommendation: (a). This is orthogonal to iteration 551's stated scope but a natural follow-up.
